record_contract: One structured record per build, newest first. Required: build, status, title, summary (<= 2 sentences). Optional: started, completed, track, movement, supersedes, evidence, risks_forward, docs{agreement,validation,handover} (repo-relative paths under docs/history/). Full detail lives in the linked doc; do not restate it here. Status vocabulary must stay within utils/project_plan.py STATUS_VALUES.
